checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman from the portrait
must.why: Same hair, sweater, park background and face; slight drift in features but recognizable.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: Audio was not transcribed; the model writes speech itself so wording is unverified.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth is open in varied shapes across frames and closes to a smile at the end; sync itself cannot be verified.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech
must.why: Frames are square, clip is 8 s, audio has peak -1.1 dB; language and friendliness cannot be heard.
No text overlays in any frame.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text, as requested; the spoken words cannot be verified.

faults.what: Frame at 3.2 s shows a wide-open mouth with eyes half-closed in a slightly distorted expression; mild exaggeration.
Face is slightly shifted and different in proportion from the original, and the subject is a little larger/closer in frame.
Spoken words not verifiable; the model may have altered or added words.

summary: The clip keeps the woman's look and park setting, with a moving mouth, no captions and a square frame; the exact wording and the voice could not be checked.
